items.question: In the UAE tourist tax-free shopping scheme, what is the minimum purchase amount in AED for a tax-free purchase?
items.fact: Tax-free purchase valid on minimum expenditure of AED 250

items.question: In the UAE tourist tax-free shopping scheme, within how many days of the purchase date must a tourist validate the transaction at the airport?
items.gold: Within 90 days of the purchase date.
items.fact: Tourist must validate transaction at airport within 90 days
